rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person who investigates or explores a subject, especially in formal or written contexts.

example.english: This explorer specializes in studying ancient civilizations.
example.traditional: 呢位探索者專門研究古代文明。
example.jyutping: ne1 wai6 taam3 sok3 ze2 zyun1 mun4 jin4 gau3 gu2 doi6 man4 ming4

rows.note: Use this for someone who travels on expeditions to discover unfamiliar places or information.

example.english: That explorer joined an expedition to explore places no one had visited before.
example.traditional: 嗰位探險家參加遠征隊，去探索以前冇人到過嘅地方。
example.jyutping: go2 wai6 taam3 him2 gaa1 caam1 gaa1 jyun5 zing1 deoi6 heoi3 taam3 sok3 ji5 cin4 mou5 jan4 dou3 gwo3 ge3 dei6 fong1
